visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with blonde hair in twin braids and a white puff-sleeve top stands outside a building. She holds a small egg tart in her right hand and points at it with her left index finger while speaking animatedly to the camera. Behind her, a KFC logo is visible through a glass door. (2) The scene shifts to a closer shot of the woman. She takes a bite of the tart, covering her mouth with her hand while widening her eyes in an expression of pleasant surprise. (3) The shot cuts back to a medium view as she continues to talk, holding the tart and gesturing. (4) The scene transitions to an indoor studio setting with a clean, light-colored background. The woman holds up pink and purple product packaging featuring cartoon bears. Close-up shots show four different colored packages (purple, green, pink, orange) arranged on a wooden board. (5) A macro close-up shows a silver spoon scooping into the egg tart, revealing a smooth, yellow ice-cream-like interior. The tart shell appears thick and flaky. (6) The woman appears back in the studio frame, holding a tart to her cheek and smiling broadly. The video ends with a promotional graphic displaying four tarts, four packages, and a large egg tart overlay.
